title: Every small etale covering family is an fpqc covering
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $(f_i:U_i\to U)$ be any covering family in its small etale site $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Then $(f_i)_i$ is an fpqc covering of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]: each $f_i$ is flat, and for every affine open $V\subseteq U$ there are finitely many indices $i_j$ and affine opens $V_j\subseteq U_{i_j}$ whose images under $f_{i_j}$ have union exactly $V$.

source.place: Tag 022C (topologies-lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), lines 3043–3077; specialized to etale coverings; also Tag 03O4 (etale-cohomology-remark-fpqc-finest), etale-cohomology.tex lines 1086–1095

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff to the covering hypothesis. For each point x of U.left, membership in the resulting union of ranges gives an index i and membership of x in the range of (f i).left. Thus the underlying family is jointly surjective.

Every underlying morphism (f i).left is etale by the Mathlib instances for morphisms in T.Etale. Etale morphisms are flat and locally of finite presentation. Scheme.ofArrows_mem_precoverage_iff combines these properties with joint surjectivity to place the family in fppfPrecoverage.

Apply Mathlib Scheme.fppfPrecoverage_le_fpqcPrecoverage. This comparison proves the required quasi-compact covering condition from openness of flat locally finitely presented morphisms; its finite-open-subcover argument is the argument of Stacks Tag 022C. Together with flatness this gives fpqcPrecoverage membership.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Topologies Lemma 022C (tag verified in tags/tags; topologies.tex 3043-3065) and Remark 03O4 (etale-cohomology.tex 1086-1095), the definitions def-weil-pbc-etale-site (covering families are jointly surjective families of etale morphisms) and def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering (flat, and every affine open of the target is a finite union of images of affine opens), and the only citer lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf, whose step uses only that an etale covering family is an fpqc covering; the statement is kept. Proof in four steps following 022C: flatness from the definition of etale; restriction of the family over an affine open V to an etale jointly surjective family g_i: f_i^{-1}(V) -> V (open immersions etale, composition and cancellation: lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation); the finite affine refinement over the affine V by the existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement (Tag 0218, which carries 022C's openness plus quasi-compactness argument); the two clauses of the fpqc definition. No new node. Mathlib: no single declaration; etalePrecoverage <= fpqcPrecoverage on the big site is le_trans of etalePrecoverage_le_proetalePrecoverage (Sites/Proetale.lean:72) and proetalePrecoverage_le_fpqcPrecoverage (:61), recorded as a candidate in the searches.
